mapper.select: select bd.id, parent_id, ancestors, dept_name from bedrock_admin_dept bad inner join bedrock_dept bd on bad.dept_id = bd.id where bad.admin_id = #{adminId} and bd.is_deleted = 0

select bd.id, bd.dept_name, bd.dept_code, bd.remark, bd.sort, bd.level, bd.parent_id, bd.ancestors, bd.category, if(bd.parent_id = 0, '顶级', (select bdp.dept_name from bedrock_dept bdp where bdp.id = bd.parent_id)) as parentName from bedrock_dept bd where bd.id = #{id} and bd.is_deleted = 0
select bd.id, bd.parent_id, bd.dept_name as deptName, bd.dept_code as deptCode, bd.sort, bd.remark, bd.category, bd.create_time from bedrock_dept bd where bd.is_deleted = 0
